## 6. Key Project Case Studies

### Project 1: Chartes.tech — Multi-Tenant Social Media Automation & Scheduling Platform
- **URL**: https://chartes.tech
- **Role**: Full-Stack Architect & Lead Developer
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, TypeScript, Redis Queues, FastAPI, PostgreSQL
- **Problem**: Brands and digital agencies juggle fragmented social media channels, hit rate limits, and suffer failed posts due to expired tokens.
- **Solution**: Engineered a distributed scheduling platform with multi-tenant workspace isolation, asynchronous Redis job queues, automated OAuth token refresh cycles, and multi-network dispatch.
- **Impact**: Delivered reliable, high-throughput campaign broadcasting for multi-account agency workflows.

### Project 2: DIGIPANCH — AI-Powered Smart Panchayat Governance System
- **URL**: https://www.digipanch.live
- **Role**: Creator & Full-Stack Engineer
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, pgvector, Google Gemini AI, AWS
- **Problem**: Rural administrative processes suffer from paper-based file loss, citizen delays, lack of transparency, and manual document verification.
- **Solution**: Built an e-governance platform featuring separate portals for citizens and panchayat officers, an AI citizen assistant with pgvector RAG powered by Google Gemini, ImageKit document scanning, and Razorpay fee collections.
- **Impact**: Revolutionized rural governance with a 100% digital, auditable administrative workflow.

### Project 3: POYODHARA — Premium Product Showcase Storefront
- **URL**: https://poyodhara.vercel.app/
- **Role**: UI/UX Designer & Frontend Engineer
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, GSAP 3.15, ScrollTrigger
- **Problem**: Regional packaged beverage and bottled water brands lacked high-quality digital brand presence and modern interactive storefronts.
- **Solution**: Designed and engineered an experiential product showcase highlighting 8-stage water purification, eco-packaging, and distributor inquiry funnels with GSAP pinned reel animations.
- **Impact**: Boosted brand credibility and elevated B2B wholesale distributor engagement.

### Project 4: HEEYAKU — EdTech OS & Academy Management Platform
- **URL**: https://heeyaku.com
- **Role**: Product Architect & Lead Engineer
- **Tech Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, DRM Video LMS, WhatsApp API, Lead CRM
- **Problem**: Educational academies face fragmented tools across lead generation, video course piracy, and unorganized student messaging.
- **Solution**: Architected a unified OS combining lead capture CRM, DRM-protected video streaming, high-speed student portals, and automated WhatsApp course notifications.
- **Impact**: Streamlined academy operations from lead acquisition to course delivery into a single high-performance system.

### Project 5: BEYOND PINKS — High-Conversion Fashion E-Commerce Platform
- **URL**: https://byondpinks.vercel.app/
